
{{alias}}( arrays )
    Subtracts a scalar constant from each element in an input one-dimensional
    double-precision complex floating-point ndarray and assigns the results to
    elements in a one-dimensional double-precision complex floating-point
    output ndarray.

    Parameters
    ----------
    arrays: ArrayLikeObject<ndarray>
        Array-like object containing the following ndarrays:

        - a one-dimensional input ndarray.
        - a one-dimensional output ndarray.
        - a zero-dimensional ndarray containing the scalar constant to subtract.

    Returns
    -------
    out: ndarray
        Output ndarray.

    Examples
    --------
    > var xbuf = [ -2.0, 1.0, 3.0, -5.0 ];
    > var x = new {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/vector/complex128}}( xbuf );
    > var w = new {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/vector/complex128}}( 2 );
    > var opts = { 'dtype': 'complex128' };
    > var a = new {{alias:@stdlib/complex/float64/ctor}}( 5.0, 0.0 );
    > var alpha = {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/from-scalar}}( a, opts );
    > {{alias}}( [ x, w, alpha ] )
    <ndarray>[ <Complex128>[ -7.0, 1.0 ], <Complex128>[ -2.0, -5.0 ] ]

    See Also
    --------
